notes: The `אֲשֶׁר ... שָׁם` fusion is the one contestable unit; it was fused because *whither* still carries what both morphemes say, which is the far side of rule 30's contiguity condition that rule 35 marks out. The competing reading marks `שָׁם` unrepresented under rule 22.
*And when* both belong to the opening waw, whose own clause the ASV recasts as subordinate (rule 55); the apodosis waw is then left with no connective.
